sources_read: .qc-cache/coldwater-2026-10-01-history-hardening-r2/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx:Quality Checks!A43:D43 and Internal Quality Checks!A43:E43 (row 42; internal E43 says monitor)
evidence: Workbook Quality Checks row 42 says worse apps must not outscore better ones; Internal Quality Checks E43 says to monitor this. The frozen scoring.toml:1-11 gives zero-weight Render/Constraints gates, positive 0.6/0.2/0.2 functional/polish/visual weights, and a functional floor of 0.05. Frozen score.py:40-48 computes a positive weighted mean and zeros failed gates/floor; test.sh:213-227 runs gates before scored. The 80 functional criterion weights total 45.25, with 6 polish and 6 visual criteria; no negative criterion weight was found. Synthetic execution of the actual frozen score.py is recorded in evidence/42/score_probe.json (SHA256 20b81a1eba0213b6090045f2387f3c1b36ae6b425b08d2b8d19114c2e64a8ad0): a gate-passing but minimal functional vector (0.10, 1, 1) receives 0.46, while a functionally complete serviceable vector (1, 1, 0.5) receives 0.90; a failed shared-save gate and the exact 0.05 floor each yield zero. A plausible polished but broken app could execute an ordinary calculation and keep a snippet in a shared in-memory server, pass both gates, yet omit revision history, restart durability, rollback and conflict handling. A conforming app can use any UI/API shape and server-rendered retrieval under the gate wording; no deterministic false-fail for it was identified. The raw-evidence index is bound to the current input hash; cited computed-luna-gate.json, computed-mock-gate.json and functional-coverage.json match its SHA256 values 78638605..., 898a4a3b... and f2ef389d... . Those are scripted observations, not configured grades. There is no runtime-evidence.json record for reward_ranking_is_monotone and no controlled configured-judge scores for weak and stronger apps. The synthetic policy proof cannot establish empirical app ordering. The policy also permits a style/function tradeoff (0.10,1,1 => 0.46 versus 0.70,0,0 => 0.42), whose product ranking needs actual app evidence and review of public visual/usability requirements.
suggested_fix: Run the full configured judge on a controlled weak app and a clearly stronger conforming app, retain hash-bound logs and criterion scores, and repair any observed inversion in a new candidate.
